verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served at docs.crossmint.com (HTTP 200) with a product summary. Crossmint also has a dedicated AI-assistants docs page for ingesting its docs into Cursor/Copilot, including a query server that returns only the most relevant sections. Doc pages are also served as .md files. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and detail on the llms.txt's scope (e.g., a full-content variant).
